entities.name: Mughal Empire
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Empire that ruled most of the Indian subcontinent (1526–1857). Under rulers like Akbar, it achieved a golden age of art, architecture (Taj Mahal), and administrative innovation, governing one of the world's wealthiest and most populous regions.
